task:
FIX FOUR REVIEW FINDINGS ON PR #798 (Finder step 0 status action). Target branch codex/run-38011726130-1, expected head bd94862; fail closed and write nothing if it moved. Only scripts/operator/actions/v3-derived-lifecycle-status.sh, tests/test_v3_derived_lifecycle_status.py, docs/operations/v3-finder-production-rollout-state.md and CHANGES.md may change.

FINDING 1 (P2, script ~line 186, worker inspection): when `docker inspect` fails for any reason the worker is reported exists=false/running=false, which makes all_named_workers_stopped and ready_for_governed_plan true — unknown state must fail closed. CHANGE: in inspect_worker(), treat a non-zero exit as 'absent' ONLY when stderr contains 'No such object' (docker's exact wording for a missing container; also accept 'No such container'); any other failure (timeout, daemon error) yields {exists: null, running: null, status: null, inspect_error: <last stderr line, max 240 chars>} and is counted as UNKNOWN. all_named_workers_stopped is true only when every worker is either absent or has running == False; any unknown worker makes it false and adds failure code 'worker_state_unknown' to failures (so status is 'stopped' and exit 1).

FINDING 2 (P2, ~line 135, text fields with newlines/tabs): psql unaligned output splits a `failure`/`failure_reason` containing a newline into extra rows and the fixed-index comprehensions raise IndexError. CHANGE: make every query that returns free-text columns emit a single JSON value per row instead of tab-separated fields — e.g. wrap each row as `SELECT json_build_object(...)::text` or `row_to_json(t)::text` and parse each output line with json.loads, so embedded newlines/tabs are escaped by PostgreSQL. (psql -At prints one JSON text per line; newlines inside JSON strings are escaped as \\n.) Apply this to the canonical_generations, derived_generations, derived_products, spatial_generations, schema_migrations and footprint relation queries (anything with text columns from user-influenced data). Keep the receipt field names identical. Add a test with a canned failure text containing a newline and a tab proving the receipt still parses and preserves the text.

FINDING 3 (P1, ~line 745, fresh_generation_estimate): averaging table bytes over 'generations present' is misleading (p4 is partial) and the archetype/post-010 search relations do not exist before migrations 010/011, so the receipt returns null for the planned 1.59-billion-row product while the ops doc claimed this replaces the sample extrapolation. CHANGE: (a) rename the section to 'measured_footprint_attribution' and compute per-generation attribution PROPORTIONALLY from chunk receipts (generation_systems / sum of systems over all generations with receipts for that product), reporting for each relation and generation {attributed_bytes, share, generation_complete (chunk receipts' systems == derived_generation.expected_systems)} and a top-level note 'proportional attribution by chunk-receipt system counts; partial generations are flagged'; (b) add 'planned_relations_not_measurable_here': ['v3_derived.system_search (post-010 row width)', 'v3_derived.system_archetype', 'v3_derived.system_archetype_summary'] with the text 'size these on a disposable PostgreSQL 18 sample and extrapolate; see docs/operations/v3-finder-production-rollout-state.md'; (c) remove any 'bytes_per_generation_if_evenly_split' field. In docs/operations/v3-finder-production-rollout-state.md change the sentence added for the footprint so it says the step 0 receipt supplies measured live sizes and free space as INPUTS to the disk decision but does NOT replace the required disposable-sample measurement of the post-010 system_search row width and the system_archetype/summary relations and indexes.

FINDING 4 (P2, ~line 510, missing pointers): current_canonical_generation / current_derived_generation may be empty; the receipt stores null yet 'current_pointers_recorded' is true. CHANGE: current_pointers_recorded is true only when the canonical pointer row AND the derived pointer row are present (non-null) AND, when v3_spatial.current_spatial_generation exists, its pointer row is present; otherwise false, add failure code 'current_pointer_missing' and status 'stopped'. ready_for_governed_plan remains all_named_workers_stopped AND current_pointers_recorded.

TESTS: extend tests/test_v3_derived_lifecycle_status.py behavioural coverage: docker inspect returning exit 1 with 'Error: No such object: <name>' -> absent; exit 1 with 'Cannot connect to the Docker daemon' -> unknown, status stopped, ready_for_governed_plan false; empty derived pointer -> current_pointer_missing; newline/tab in failure text parsed correctly; proportional attribution numbers for two canned generations (one partial). CHANGES.md: adjust this branch's step-0 entry wording to match (inputs to the disk decision, not a replacement for the sample measurement).

VALIDATION: 1. bash -n the script  2. python -m pytest tests/test_v3_derived_lifecycle_status.py tests/test_v3_app_status.py -q -p no:cacheprovider  3. ruff on the extracted heredoc body  4. git diff --name-only bd94862 lists only the four allowed files. Commit message: 'ops: step 0 status fails closed on unknown workers/pointers; JSON-safe text; honest footprint attribution'.
